headline_artifact: Average logit difference (Logit['swift'] - Logit['quick']) for INSTRUCT vs BASE, computed in the cells following model loading and get_cache().
blockers: Code hardcodes two separate CUDA devices (cuda:0 and cuda:1), assuming a multi-GPU machine; a single-3090 box has only one device
No dtype override anywhere -- TransformerLens default fp32 for two 8B models exceeds a single 24GB card even after unifying devices
No requirements file; transformer_lens/jaxtyping/fancy_einsum/circuitsvis versions must be inferred from imports

notes: A competent engineer could rewrite this to run both models in bf16 on one GPU with activation caches swapped/offloaded to fit 24GB, but that's a real code change (device unification + dtype + memory management), not a config flag -- as authored it assumes a 2-GPU, full-precision machine.

OPENAI_API_KEY required for the gpt-5-nano math-equivalence grader fallback used during every training step
